title: NewJeans Cover The Face, Talk Life as a Group
content:
NewJeans appeared on the cover of The Face's June issue, with the British monthly publishing an exclusive interview on May 29, 2024.

Hanni described living together as a group, saying it had helped the members learn about one another and grow close. She compared the experience to an extended school trip shared with friends.

Minji pointed to the group's global fanbase as a source of motivation, saying the support from Bunnies drives the members to keep pushing boundaries and making music that connects with people. Haerin reflected on the lesson she has taken from the group's rapid rise: enjoying the moment when you can, even when circumstances are difficult.

The June issue also featured conversations with model Alex Consani, Little Simz and Erykah Badu, and Skepta.

title: Bunnies Camp 2024 Tokyo Dome Sells Out Both Nights
content:
NewJeans sold out both nights of its Bunnies Camp 2024 Tokyo Dome fan meeting, with the June 26 and June 27 shows filling the venue in Japan.

The event marked the group's first fan meeting in Japan and made NewJeans the fastest non-Japanese act to perform at Tokyo Dome, reaching the venue 23 months after debut. The two shows drew a combined 91,200 fans.

Bunnies Camp was built around music rather than the usual fan-meeting games, with a set spanning the group's EPs and singles as well as new tracks from the How Sweet and Supernatural releases. YOASOBI joined the first night, while Rina Sawayama appeared on the second.

Organizers later released additional restricted-view seats for both dates after the initial run sold out.

title: NewJeans Tease 2024 Double Single and 2025 World Tour
content:
NewJeans announced a pair of single albums for 2024 and teased a world tour for 2025, sharing the plans through the fan communication app Phoning on March 26, 2024.

The first release, How Sweet, arrived on May 24 with the title track, B-side Bubble Gum, and instrumental versions of both songs. The second, Supernatural, followed on June 21 as the group's official Japanese debut single, pairing its title track with Right Now and instrumentals.

To mark the Japanese debut, NewJeans held the two-day Bunnies Camp 2024 Tokyo Dome fan meeting on June 26 and 27. ADOR said the group was also preparing a new album for the second half of 2024 and a world tour in 2025.

The announcement followed the group's 2023 EP Get Up and set up a busy summer of Korean and Japanese releases.

title: NewJeans Win Group of the Year at Billboard Women in Music
content:
NewJeans received the Group of the Year award at Billboard's Women in Music 2024 celebration on March 6 at the YouTube Theater in Los Angeles.

The honor recognized the group's breakout year on the Billboard charts. In 2023, NewJeans scored entries across ten Billboard charts, including five on the Hot 100, led by Super Shy at No. 48. Get Up became the group's first No. 1 album on the Billboard 200.

Lainey Wilson presented the award. NewJeans celebrated with a mashup of Super Shy and ETA, performing the former in schoolyard-inspired uniforms before taking on ETA with their dancers.

During the acceptance speech, Hanni thanked the artists in the room and said the group does not take its place in the music industry for granted. NewJeans were the first K-pop group to win the Group of the Year honor.

title: NewJeans x Nike By You Capsule Arrives in Singapore
content:
Nike launched a limited-edition Nike By You x NewJeans collection at its Orchard Road store in Singapore in late January 2024.

The capsule let Nike members personalise T-shirts, hoodies, caps, and an eco-friendly bag with graphics built around NewJeans and the group's bunny motif. Prices started at $39 and ran to $49 before customisation.

NewJeans were also scheduled to perform at the three-storey Nike Orchard Road flagship on February 3, marking the group's first performance in Singapore. Access to the invite-only show was offered through the Nike app, and attendees received first dibs on the Air Max 90 LV8 during a member shopping session.

The collaboration formed part of Nike's Member Days campaign, which ran from January 30 to February 4.

title: NewJeans Win Five Trophies at 2023 Melon Music Awards
content:
NewJeans were the biggest winners at the 2023 Melon Music Awards, taking home five trophies at the Inspire Arena in Incheon on December 2.

The group won two of the ceremony's four grand prizes: Artist of the Year and Best Song of the Year for Ditto. NewJeans were also named Best Female Group and picked up Top 10 Artist and Millions Top 10 honors.

The result came just one year and four months after the group's debut. Ditto also set a record for the longest run at No. 1 on Melon's TOP100 chart.

MMA 2023 was the first event held at the newly opened Inspire Arena. IVE won Album of the Year, NCT Dream took Record of the Year, and ZEROBASEONE and RIIZE shared New Artist of the Year.

title: NewJeans' 'Get Up' Debuts at No. 1 on Billboard 200
content:
NewJeans scored their first No. 1 album on the Billboard 200 as Get Up debuted atop the chart dated August 5, 2023.

The six-track EP earned 126,500 equivalent album units in the United States in the week ending July 27, according to Luminate. Album sales accounted for 101,500 units, with 99% of that total driven by CDs.

The result made NewJeans the second all-female group in 15 years to reach No. 1, following BLACKPINK's Born Pink. They also became the sixth K-pop act overall to top the Billboard 200.

Get Up finished just 500 units ahead of the Barbie soundtrack, which debuted at No. 2. Super Shy climbed to a new peak of No. 48 on the Hot 100 in the same chart week.

title: 'Super Shy' Hits No. 2 on Billboard Global 200
content:
NewJeans' Super Shy debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard Global 200 and Billboard Global Excl. U.S. charts dated July 22, 2023.

The song arrived with 63 million streams and 6,000 downloads sold worldwide in the week ending July 13, according to Luminate. It became the group's highest-charting single at the time and delivered the biggest one-week streaming total of their career.

Super Shy was kept from No. 1 by Olivia Rodrigo's Vampire on the Global 200 and by Myke Towers' LaLa on the Global Excl. U.S. ranking. NewJeans also debuted the track New Jeans at No. 32 and No. 19 on the two charts.

The releases arrived two weeks before Get Up, the six-track EP that later gave NewJeans their first No. 1 on the Billboard 200.

title: 'OMG' Debuts on Billboard Hot 100 at No. 91
content:
NewJeans' OMG entered the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 91 on the chart dated January 28, 2023, giving the group a second entry on the chart.

The debut followed Ditto, which arrived at No. 96 the previous week. At the time, NewJeans were the fastest K-pop group to earn multiple Hot 100 entries, doing so about six months after their July 2022 debut.

OMG later climbed to a peak of No. 74 and spent six weeks on the chart. The group joined BLACKPINK as the only K-pop girl groups with multiple Hot 100 entries at that point.

Both songs appeared on the single album OMG, which followed NewJeans' debut EP and helped establish the group's early global chart presence.
